pathResolution.rule: Every modelFiles and wasmFiles entry carries its own package name, and its path is relative to that package s own resolved root. Resolve each distinct package once through createRequire, preferring require.resolve(<name>/package.json) and falling back, for a package such as nsfwjs whose exports map does not publish that path, to resolving a published export and walking up to the nearest package.json that claims the name.
pathResolution.rationale: Never a hardcoded node_modules path. npm hoists @tensorflow/* to the workspace root today and places the nsfwjs peer alias under apps/api, and a future dedupe can move either. A manifest that verifies only one physical layout fails startup on a legitimate install; resolving through each package s own export map also fails loudly when a package is missing, which is the outcome we want.

weightBundles.rationale: The package ships the weights as base64 bundles rather than binary shards, so there is nothing on disk for a filesystem IOHandler to read and nothing to download. Pinning the decoded byte lengths and the weight-spec count catches a bundle that hashes differently only because it was re-encoded, and catches a truncated decode before it reaches loadGraphModel.

forbiddenDependenciesRationale: The union package pulls tfjs-backend-webgl, tfjs-layers and tfjs-data, which this worker never uses, and measured 286 MB installed against 88 MB for the three packages actually needed. It produces identical class probabilities, so its only effect here is to triple the image the Story 6.2b worker has to fit inside a free hosting tier.
thresholdsMirrorOf: the image block of the policy file named by manifest.policy
thresholdsRationale: AC 1 requires the manifest to pin the thresholds, and the policy file owns them. This block therefore mirrors exactly four policy values and nothing else, so a consumer can assert it key-for-key against the same-named policy fields. The loader makes that assertion and fails startup on any divergence, so the duplication cannot silently drift.

runtime.concurrencyRationale: One inference per model process. Additional throughput comes from worker replicas, not from a higher per-process concurrency, until signed evidence shows a higher value stays inside the same memory and latency gates.

performance.rationale: The absolute ceilings bound a pathological run and sit far above what this stack actually costs, so they cannot detect a regression on their own. The measurement command fills `measured` with warm p95, warm p99, cold startup and peak RSS from at least 1,000 warm inferences after warmup, and fills `regressionGate` at three times each measured value. Both stay null until a real measurement runs, so an unmeasured manifest can never be read as a passing gate.
